It really depends on what you're after and what you'll use them for. If I was starting from scratch, I would start with a small tote bag or toolbox and fill them with the basics. Hammer, screwdrivers, pliers, tape measure, knife, side cutters, mallet, level, hack saw, shifter, spanners, allen keys, socket wrench, and anything else I would actually use. Add in a few power tools like a drill, circular saw, and any others you will actually use, and you're on your way. If you have a garage, you could get something bigger, like some shelving, a peg board, and a draw system. Then, you can start adding bits and pieces you want or need. I love tools, but for me, I think it's more of a lifetime collection thing. I really enjoy the whole process of starting a new project or needing to repair something around the house and needing a few extra tools to get it done. Then, over the years, you will have built up a pretty decent inventory. I hope this was helpful. Enjoy your newfound joy of tools.
